title: Axis identities from the signed tensor-row formula
statement: Let X,U,F,G,D be as in [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data]. Let h be a morphism from the tensor total of the left and right Cech totals to the target total [def-sc-cup-cech-total]. Assume h satisfies the signed row formula: on included row cochains in bidegrees (r,i),(s,j), its value is (-1)^(i*s) times the inclusion of the explicit row pairing [new-cup-cech-pair-cochain] in bidegree (r+s,i+j). Then h takes tensors of alpha images of global cochains to alpha of D.pair, and tensors of beta images of coefficient Cech cochains to beta of their cechCupCochain [def-sc-cech-cup-product]. The normalization assumption is essential; the claim is not for arbitrary cochain morphisms.

source.place: Equation 07MB; alpha restriction and beta augmentation formulas, also visible in the flasque diagram of Lemma 0FKV

proof.text: For alpha, specialize the assumed row formula to Cech degrees zero. Compute zero-cochain restrictions using the product projections. Composite restrictions and D.restriction identify the tuplewise pair with restriction of the global pair. Apply the target total inclusion.

For beta, specialize to resolution degrees zero. The Cech functor map acts tuplewise, by its projection/naturality identity. Move augmentations through face restrictions and apply D.augmentation_pair. Unfold cechCupCochain and apply the target inclusion. Both axis Koszul signs are one.

theorem cupCech_total_cochain_axes {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) {F G : X.Modules} (D : CupResolutionPairing F G)
    (h : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor
      ((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
      ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
      (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤))) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶
      ((cupCechDouble U D.target.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)))
    (hh : ∀ (r s i j m n : ℕ) (hm : r + i = m) (hn : s + j = n)
      (a : ((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).X r).X i)
      (b : ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).X s).X j),
      h.f (m + n)
        (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
          ((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
          ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
          (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤))) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
          m n (m + n) rfl
          (((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
              r i m (by simpa using hm) a) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
            ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
              s j n (by simpa using hn) b))) =
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i * s) •
          (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
            (r + s) (i + j) (m + n) (by dsimp; omega)
            (cupCechPairCochain U D r s i j a b)) :
      (∀ (p q : ℕ) (a : (cupSections D.left).X p) (b : (cupSections D.right).X q),
        h.f (p + q)
          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
            ((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
            ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
            (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤))) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
            p q (p + q) rfl
            (((cupCechAlpha U D.left).f p a) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
              ((cupCechAlpha U D.right).f q b))) =
        (cupCechAlpha U D.target).f (p + q) (D.pair p q ⊤ a b)) ∧
      (∀ (p q : ℕ)
        (a : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).X p)
        (b : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj G.presheafModuleCat).X q),
        h.f (p + q)
          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
            ((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
            ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
            (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤))) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
            p q (p + q) rfl
            (((cupCechBeta U D.left).f p a) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
              ((cupCechBeta U D.right).f q b))) =
        (cupCechBeta U D.target).f (p + q) (cechCupCochain U F G p q a b))
